subtitle: Smiling Coast Massage
nameMeaning: The name Nafa comes from Mandinka, one of the principal languages of The Gambia. It means that which does good, that which nourishes, that which benefits.
story: Nafa Wellness was born from a deep conviction: that healing is not a luxury, but a right. Founded by Aminata Sama Corr, a CRMTA-certified massage therapist based in Edmonton, Alberta, Nafa Wellness brings professional, personalised massage therapy directly to your door. Aminata brings with her not only her professional certification and training, but the warmth, the presence, and the healing knowledge of her roots. Every session is designed to make you feel held, restored, and truly cared for.
mission: To bring professional, certified massage therapy to the comfort of your own space, with the warmth and personal care that makes every session feel like coming home.
positioning: Nafa Wellness is a premium mobile massage therapy service in Edmonton, Alberta. For busy professionals, active individuals, expectant mothers, and anyone seeking genuine restoration, Aminata Sama Corr brings certified, personalised care directly to your door, with the warmth of someone who truly knows how to heal.
